name: How much does it cost to widen a doorway for walker access?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to widen a doorway for walker access?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to widen a doorway for walker access varies based on several factors, including the existing wall construction (e.g., drywall, plaster, load-bearing), the need for new framing, patching and painting, and the type of new door and frame chosen. Simple widening projects for non-load-bearing walls can be less expensive than those requiring structural modifications. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost to widen a doorway varies based on wall construction, structural needs, finish work, and new door selection.
